releases.notes:
## 1.0.246

- Support World of Warcraft: Forever (1.60.1, interface 16001) and Retail in one package.
- Use the Forever client's specialization and talent APIs. Refresh alert conditions after a dual-talent group switch, and keep captured cooldown data scoped to the active specialization.
- Fix cooldown and Bloodlust aura checks on clients that restrict combat data.
- Open settings with the configuration addon's embedded QFXWidgets. QFX Addon Manager can still open the same settings window.
- Give dropdown options more room and size short menus to their contents. Use Blizzard's checkmark texture for cached specializations and configured voice events.

## 1.0.245

- Default the saved alert list to class, then specialization order. All-class/all-specialization alerts come first, followed by all-specialization alerts within each class; preserve the existing order within the same scope.
- Preserve explicit drag positions across refreshes and UI reloads. Keep collections and their children together, and keep loaded/unloaded ordering independent.
- Fix saving positions when dragging entries back to their root list. Reordering children inside a collection no longer disables default sorting for unrelated root entries.
- Record each successful drag's display position once and remove three unused duplicate serializer/compression files from the main addon; the configuration addon retains the active libraries.
- Retain the installed optional QFX Addon Manager notice-queue integration for pending-apply and legacy-cleanup prompts, including scope and pending-count rechecks before delayed prompts appear.
- Legacy list snapshots do not distinguish automatic and manual ordering, so the initial update regroups them by scope. Subsequent explicit drag positions override the default.
- Preserve existing alert settings, playback behavior, and standalone/manager settings support. No player SavedVariables files are modified.

## 1.0.244

- Fix false Ready voice announcements when changing maps, entering instances, or passing through loading screens.
- Suspend game-cooldown watches during loading, then silently rebuild them after world entry and a short settling delay. Already-ready spells and stale cooldown-start casts are not replayed.
- Preserve real cooldown evidence across configuration refreshes and avoid priming a watch from a GCD alone.
- Keep fixed cooldown timers and saved alert settings intact.
- Validation: all 35 regression scripts pass, including loading-event ordering, consecutive transfers, cooldown completion, charge watches, and fixed timers. Actual audio playback still requires in-game verification.

## 1.0.243

- Fix TTS voice selection when the saved system voice is no longer available: use the first installed voice as a fallback.
- Preserve the selected standard voice when it is available, including voice ID 0, and report when no TTS voices are installed.
- Add regression coverage for custom TTS text in cooldown, cast-success, event, and Bloodlust alerts.
- Saved alert settings are unchanged. In-game audio verification is still required for affected clients.

## 1.0.242

- Fix the execution action menu being disabled when selecting Ready or On Cooldown. Sound, image, and text actions can now be selected in both modes.
- Preserve the existing numeric countdown restrictions, aura voice-only behavior, and saved alert settings.
- Apply the fix to both standalone settings and QFX Addon Manager-rendered settings.
